raw_market.question: 1Q Spread: Marshall (-0.5)
raw_market.description:
In the first quarter of the college football game between Coastal Carolina and Marshall, scheduled for October 10 at 7:00 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Marshall" if Marshall outscore Coastal Carolina by 1 or more points in the first quarter.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Coastal Carolina".

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
